path_conclusions.geometry_inference_limit: Zero AABB candidate pairs means no SAT candidate classifications were exercised in these particular states; closed-distance and finite normal-ray are different geometric diagnostics. No whole-set containment or mechanism self-overlap test is claimed.
path_conclusions.return_limit: Tiny signed returned displacements/forces are retained; no threshold, snap-to-zero, physical hysteresis or contact proof is inferred.
path_conclusions.peak_positive_separation: Bottom finite-face outward ray is positive; its endpoint/corner minimum differs from closed boundary minimum and source node-window proxy. Positive saved distances and lack of overlaps do not qualify contact/clamping/pressure.

CSV_checks: All 1836 new and 1377 prior node records match their original accepted indices, node ID order and exact saved signed global-vector components byte-for-byte. Four disjoint group counts agree with saved summaries.
reporting_qualification: Fresh mechanical reference evidence is external; this saved-summary task adds no mechanical/HP qualification. Pressure, energy, stress-HP, all tangent columns, derived nodal moments, face-allocation and clamp/contact qualification remain outside this summary.
author_summary_revision: Before delivery, added positive/negative/signed-fsum nodal budgets from the same already-bound CSV values; ordinary saved reductions only, no source or science-file changes.
